monthly_rent.line: Monthly rent is ₹30,000, payable on or before the fifth day of each month.

security_deposit.line: The Tenant shall pay ₹90,000, equal to three months of rent, as an interest-free refundable security deposit.

total_length.line: The initial term starts on 1 October 2026 and ends on 30 September 2027.

tenant_notice.line: The Tenant may request early termination by giving sixty days’ written notice

tenant_can_leave_early.line: The Tenant may request early termination by giving sixty days’ written notice

landlord_can_end_early.line: The Landlord may seek termination for material breach after written notice and subject to applicable law.

rent_increase.line: On each renewal anniversary, monthly rent increases by seven percent over the rent payable immediately before renewal.

maintenance.line: Garden maintenance of ₹1,200 per month shall be paid by the Tenant.

auto_renewal.line: At the end of the initial term, this Agreement automatically renews for successive twelve-month periods unless the Landlord gives written notice of non-renewal at least ninety days before the end of the current term.
